readmeExcerpt: This sample demonstrates how to use Go, `godror`, and Oracle AI Database JSON Relational Duality Views together. The program creates a `student` table, creates a `student_dv` duality view, inserts JSON data into the view, and queries the JSON document back.
highlights: Oracle client libraries available through DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH
An Oracle AI Database instance reachable at localhost:1521/freepdb1
metaTitle: Go JSON Relational Duality Views Sample | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Go sample for creating and querying JSON Relational Duality Views in Oracle AI Database.
